verdicts.why: Asked 'how do I say my favorite on its own' he guessed إشي and هو, Amal said 'No' and supplied عندي, so it is a voiced supplied-word (didn't-know, tier 0).

He said بوظة المفضل (masc adjective on feminine noun) and only later, at 15:35 and 16:08, did he ask whether it should be مفضلة, so the 13:48 line is a real agreement slip that passed (grammar-B, her chat el-buza el-mufaddala confirms).
He guessed the wrong plural مسلسلين for 'shows' and Amal supplied مسلسلات, which is a voiced fix of a plural he invented (asked/didn't-know).

After the 23:05 attempt he said بحيرة التانية with el- only on the adjective, and Amal recast البحيرة الثانية at 23:32 and he took it ('that's right'); it is a fresh wrong form 20 s later, not a self-fix.
Amal answered his demonstrative with the explicit choice 'هذي or هادا؟' for masculine منظر and he then said هذا نفس المنظر, a voiced prompt-then-fix of the feminine هادي (engine wrote عادي).
She had just given غير نوع at 38:22, he said أنواع (not a repeat of her form), and she answered 'That's types' so he switched to نوع; the wrong number was fixed out loud.
He again said أنواع مختلفين الأكل with no من about 80 s after her 45:48 fix, and she asked 'Where's the من?', so it is a second voiced fix of a wrong form, not a within-30-s repeat.
Right after supplying من he said من أكل without el-, and Amal recast من الأكل (she had also said الأكل at 45:27); this is a separate el- slip from the missing-من one and he repeated her fix.
He invented the plurals لُعب and لُعبات and Amal gave ألعاب at 1:06:01, a voiced fix of a plural form of a noun he knows.

Immediately after repeating her ألعاب he said اللعب again and she cut in with 'أي أي أي... ألعاب' a second time, so the wrong form came back and was fixed again (own slip per the 10-08 عيان precedent).
